<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Updates the properties of credentials.

Send only the fields you want to change. Fields you omit are left as they are and aren't
validated. An empty string resets `Alias` to the login name, `HomeDirectory` to
`/home/{UserName}` and `ChrootDirectory` to `/`.

On a plan without inbound rules, changes to `Settings.Network.InboundRules` are skipped without
an error and the rest of the update applies.

Changes apply to new connections; open sessions aren't interrupted. To change the password,
rotate it instead.


:::info

Only some plans include inbound rules (`Settings.Network.InboundRules`). Read more about our different plans [here](https://sftptogo.com/pricing).

:::
